name: git_compose_read
description: Read the patch bodies of collected hunks, selected by `hunk_indices` or by `files` (exactly one of the two), so you can understand changes you did not write before authoring a plan. Fails with stale_collection if the changes were edited since git_compose_collect. Read-only.

files.description: File paths to read all hunks of, as listed by git_compose_collect

hunk_indices.description: Hunk indices to read, as listed by git_compose_collect

max_bytes.description: Maximum patch bytes to return (default 50000, max 200000). Omitted hunks are listed in omitted_indices; read them in another call.
